title: hotfix: enforce SLOs with improved circuit breakers and load-shedding + regional failover
author: Jordan Kim
description:
Motivation: After last week's incident we observed cascading latency spikes when a subset of model workers experienced degraded GPU health. This PR hardens SLO enforcement by tightening circuit breaker thresholds, adding fast-path load-shedding for low-priority routes, and improving regional failover logic. The goal is to preserve high-priority customer traffic and prevent cluster-wide degradation while keeping user-visible error rates within the target 99th latency SLOs.

What changed: consolidated SLO enforcement into a single controller (controller/slo_enforcer.go) that emits consistent metrics, introduced a two-tier circuit breaker in the runtime (runtime/circuit_breaker.go) with early short-circuiting and extended exponential backoff, implemented a conservative load-shedder (runtime/load_shedder.go) that applies route-level priorities and token-bucket allowances, and improved region-failover decision making to prefer same-region warm fallback pools before cross-region spillover. Also includes hotfix telemetry and alerting tweaks to avoid pager noise during controlled failovers.

Testing: unit tests for new controllers and runtime logic included, integration canary exercised in us-west-2 with synthetic traffic patterns that reproduce the incident. Canary run shows error budget preserved for high-priority routes and 30% reduction in cross-region migrations under the same fault injection.

Risk and rollout: conservative default thresholds; feature gated by runtime flag `enable_strict_slo_enforcement`. Rollout plan: enable for internal customers and a small canary group for 24 hours, then full rollout if metrics are stable. Rollback is a single flag flip and immediate circuit-breaker reset.

Notes: This is a hotfix intended to be fast-tracked; follow-up PRs will refactor metrics namespaces and add dynamic threshold tuning based on workload profiles.

rollback_plan: Flip deploy/feature_flags.yaml:enable_strict_slo_enforcement=false, trigger runtime config reload, and call /admin/reset-circuit-breakers endpoint. Monitor slo_enforcer.metrics.short_circuit_count and slo_error_budget.*. If error_budget increases, revert and open incident. Estimated rollback time ~3-5 minutes.
release_notes:
- Hotfix: stricter SLO enforcement controller to prevent cascading latency spikes
- Two-tier circuit breakers with early short-circuiting for degraded workers
- Route-aware load-shedding to preserve high-priority traffic
- Improved regional failover heuristic to prefer warm pools before cross-region spillover
- New telemetry: short_circuit_count, route_shed_rate, slo_enforcer_decisions
